strings.intro: Drag a question onto the timeline, or tap it, and see whether the model can reach the answer.
strings.landedBefore: {q} The answer is from before the cutoff, so it was in the training text. The model answers from memory.
strings.blocked: {q} The answer is from after the cutoff. Without search, the model has never seen it. Whatever it says now is a guess.
strings.throughWindow: {q} The answer is from after the cutoff, but search is on, so the model reads a web page first and answers from that.
strings.timeless: {q} This was true long before the cutoff and is still true, so the training text covers it.
strings.done: You've tried both sides of the wall. That's the whole idea: the cutoff decides what a model knows on its own, and search is a window that is not always open.

cards.text: What was in the news this morning?
